title: 第23章 烟雨林藏静 溪涧夜栖安第24章 晨溪同濯影 幽谷遇灵花
lines: 确认翠甲灵蚁族群被远远甩开后，再无尾随追来，两人这才缓缓收住脚步。紧绷的心神稍稍松缓，两人并肩倚在古木之下，大口粗重地喘息。
先前承受苍龙无上威压所受的内伤本就滞涩难愈，方才一路极限狂奔，更是牵动周身气血翻涌，胸腔阵阵闷痛，体内灵气耗损严重，四肢皆是酸软乏力。
二人稍作调息，便继续朝着正南方向前行，一路穿行不断，周遭原本苍郁干燥的古林景致渐渐更迭，空气中湿气越来越浓，淡淡烟霭自林间深处缓缓弥漫开来。两人已彻底步入新的地域烟雨林。
此地隶属于无尽东海沿岸密林正南。
整片林海终年萦绕着缥缈轻烟，淡青色雾霭缠绕虬曲古木，浮荡于枝叶间隙，终年不散。日光穿透层层烟岚洒落林间，被柔化得温润朦胧，古树枝干苍劲挺拔，枝叶常年浸润水汽，缀满晶莹清露，树干遍覆青润苔藓，林下芳草湿软，各色幽隐花草藏于漫山烟幕之中。林间无风而烟霭自行流转，氤氲水汽裹挟着清冽纯粹的草木幽香弥漫四方，地势平缓幽静，此前天地间残存的磅礴龙威、蚁群的腥戾气息，尽数被这片漫山烟岚隔绝消融。
待气息稍稍平稳，二人抬眼环视四方，细细观察此地整体地形与林间风貌。
罗止正望着林间漫天萦绕不绝的轻烟雾霭，心中定下名号，神色平静，缓缓开口道：“以后这片林地，便唤作烟雨林吧。”
李紫云轻眨眼眸，望着周身朦胧如烟的景致，嘴角勾起浅浅笑意，柔声道：“烟雨林，真好听，与这里的景致格外契合。”
二人不再多做停留，一同朝着烟雨林东侧缓步前行。林间天光缓缓沉敛，暖调光影在枝叶间慢慢柔化，暮色悄然浸透整片林海。行进之间，一阵清润悠扬的流水之音穿透薄雾，隐隐萦绕耳畔。二人循着潺潺水声一路探寻，缓步深入腹地，最终罗止正与李紫云一同来到了溪鸣谷涧的前段。
这里，正是烟雨林东边——溪鸣谷涧。
此地坐落于无尽东海沿岸密林南侧，与无尽东海沿岸浅滩直线相距约三十公里。
整片幽谷呈狭长蜿蜒之势，沿着地势高低错落，一路盘绕曲折，缓缓向着密林最深处绵延延伸。谷间一条清冽山涧贯穿全程，溪水顺着凹凸的岩岸缓缓淌过，水流撞击碎石，潺潺奔流不息，清亮的水响连绵不绝，在幽静林谷中悠悠回荡。溪岸两侧，修长劲挺的青竹连片丛生，节节挺拔，翠叶婆娑，又与枝干苍劲的高大阔叶老树交错相依而生。繁密枝桠纵横交织，阔叶浓荫叠盖，竹影错落掩映，层层枝叶密密匝匝覆于谷上。
昏柔沉缓的夕阳光影，透过层层交叠的枝叶缝隙斜斜垂落，轻铺在湿润的泥地与青石板上，又洒在流动的溪水表面，映出一片片晃动细碎的粼粼光斑。谷中阴凉湿润，水汽充沛弥漫，淡淡的烟雨薄雾轻盈浮荡在溪面与竹林之间，让整片谷涧更显朦胧幽深。此地深藏于烟雨林腹地之内，四面林木合围环抱，谷口隐蔽狭窄，谷道曲折藏拙，天然隔绝外界声响与视线，隐蔽性极强。
罗止正驻足立在谷口，目光缓缓扫过狭长幽谷与贯穿其间的清浅溪涧，将周遭地形与景致尽数收入眼底，沉吟片刻，缓缓开口道：“此处谷深林静，涧水长鸣，便称它溪鸣谷涧吧。”
李紫云缓步走到一旁，抬眸望向连绵竹树与潺潺流水，眉眼柔和，轻轻颔首，柔声应道：“溪鸣谷涧，名字清雅贴切，和这片幽谷的气质再合适不过。”
二人静静环顾周遭环境，先前承受苍龙威压留下的内伤迟迟未愈，一日奔逃与厮杀本就耗损巨大，体内郁结的内伤隐隐作痛，加之林间光影愈发昏沉，暮色彻底笼罩谷间，已然不便继续赶路。
二人心意相通，决意就在溪鸣谷涧前段，寻一处安稳之地暂住休憩。
他们避开湿冷的溪岸，寻得一块背靠竹木遮挡、干燥避风的平整空地，此地隐蔽安全，又远离溪水潮气，正好适合过夜休整。
随后二人分头行动，在周边林地之中缓缓走动，一同捡拾散落的干枯枝桠、枯竹与断落朽木，收拢堆叠，攒出一小堆干燥柴火。
罗止正屈膝蹲下，伸手从裤兜取出一只防水打火机。他垂眸落于柴堆前，指尖轻按开关，一簇暖亮的火苗骤然燃起。微微俯身，小心引燃底层细枝，借着晚风缓缓引火，一点点将整堆枯枝稳稳点燃。
暖黄色的篝火缓缓跳动，驱散了谷涧的阴凉湿冷，晃动的火光映亮二人略显疲惫的眉眼，也为这片幽深朦胧的溪谷，添了一分安稳的暖意。
暮色愈发浓重，谷涧深处寒意渐起，腹中也泛起阵阵饥乏。李紫云微微抬手，指尖轻拂腰间悬挂的储物袋，从中取出两块紧实的灵獾肉。
罗止正见状，默默从篝火旁拾起两根粗细适中的干爽树枝，抬手取下腰间的骨刀。刀锋冷白锋利，他蹲身在旁，指尖稳握刀柄，慢条斯理将树枝一端细细削尖，动作利落沉稳。
处理妥当后，他伸手从李紫云手中接过两块灵獾肉，将肉块稳稳串在削好的木枝上，抬手架在篝火边缘，借着跃动的暖火慢慢炙烤。
火苗静静翻涌，文火慢炙之下，架在篝火边的灵獾肉渐渐褪去生腥，表层烤得油光透亮，通体泛着温润的焦金色泽。细密油脂不断顺着肉纹缓缓滴落，落在柴火上漾开细碎轻响，醇厚的肉香混着谷间清润的水汽，缓缓弥漫四周。
片刻过后，两块灵獾肉已然烤制熟透，外皮微焦，肉质紧实喷香。
罗止正抬手取下一串色泽最为金黄油亮的烤肉，指尖稳稳握着木枝，侧身递到李紫云面前，神色温和，语气平缓开口：“来，奔波一天，你肯定饿坏了。先吃点东西，养好体力，才能稳住内伤。”
李紫云接过烤肉，指尖轻握着木杆，碍于体内内伤未愈，动作轻柔缓慢。她垂下眉眼，小口小口细细咀嚼，温热的肉食入腹，缓缓抚平一日奔波的饥乏与体虚。她抬眸望向罗止正，轻声开口：“你也快吃吧，你肯定也饿了。”
罗止正微微点头，伸手拿起另外一串烤肉，大口大口吃了起来。温热的灵肉缓缓入腹，一股温和的气力缓缓化开，稍稍舒缓了体内郁结的内伤与整日奔劳的疲惫。
二人吃完烤肉，腹中饥乏尽数消解，喉咙微微干涩。
罗止正伸手取下腰间的银月水囊，拔开木塞，递到李紫云面前，轻声道：“刚吃完烤肉，喝点水润一润喉咙。”
李紫云接过水囊，缓缓饮下几口，清冽溪水润过喉咙，舒缓喉间干意。她抬手轻轻擦了擦唇角，随后将水囊稳稳递回给罗止正。
罗止正伸手接过，仰头饮了几口，随后将木塞仔细塞紧，把银月水囊重新系回腰间妥善收好。
吃饱喝足，周身暖意漫开，连日赶路的疲惫稍稍褪去。
夜色愈发浓重，林间晚风轻拂，夹杂着溪水潺潺的轻响，四周格外安静。
罗止正背靠竹丛缓缓坐下，目光望向身旁的李紫云，见她面色仍带着几分虚弱，开口轻声说道：“今日一路惊险奔波，你损耗极大。今夜此地安稳，你静心调息，好好稳固内伤。”
李紫云微微点头，调整坐姿，缓缓闭上双眼，凝神静气，开始运转气息调养伤势。
罗止正则守在篝火旁，时不时添上枯枝，让火势稳定燃烧。一边警惕留意谷涧四周动静，防备夜行妖兽，一边闭目沉下心神，同步调息，慢慢平复体内翻涌的气血，修补白日厮杀与狂奔留下的损耗。
content_en:
After confirming that the group of Emerald Armored Spirit Ants had been left far behind and no one was following them, the two of them slowly stopped their steps. Their tense minds relaxed slightly, and the two of them leaned side by side under the ancient trees, breathing heavily.
The internal injuries suffered from the supreme pressure of the Canglong were already stagnant and difficult to heal. Just running all the way to the limit caused the energy and blood in the whole body to surge, causing bursts of pain in the chest. The spiritual energy in the body was severely depleted, and all the limbs were sore and weak.
The two of them adjusted their breath for a moment before continuing to head due south. As they walked continuously, the scenery of the originally lush and dry ancient forest around them gradually changed. The moisture in the air became thicker and thicker, and a faint mist slowly spread from the depths of the forest. The two of them have completely entered a new area, the misty rain forest.
This place belongs to the south of the dense forest along the endless East China Sea.
The entire forest is surrounded by misty smoke all year round, and the light blue mist wraps around the ancient trees and floats in the gaps between the branches and leaves, lingering all year round. The sunlight penetrates the layers of smoke and falls into the forest, softening it to a warm and hazy state. The ancient branches are strong and straight, the branches and leaves are soaked in water vapor all year round and covered with crystal clear dew. The tree trunks are covered with green moss, the grass under the forest is soft and moist, and all kinds of hidden flowers and plants are hidden in the smoke screen of the mountains. There is no wind in the forest and the mist circulates on its own. The dense water vapor carries the clear and pure fragrance of vegetation and fills the air in all directions. The terrain is gentle and quiet. The majestic dragons and the fishy smell of the ants that were previously between the heaven and the earth are all isolated and melted by this mountain of mist.
After their breaths calmed down a bit, the two of them raised their eyes and looked around, carefully observing the overall terrain and forest features of the place.
Luo Zhi was looking at the light mist lingering in the forest. He decided on a name in his mind, looked calm, and slowly said: "From now on, this forest will be called the Misty Rain Forest."
Li Ziyun blinked his eyes lightly, looking at the hazy smoke-like scenery around him, with a slight smile on his lips, and said softly: "The misty rain forest sounds so nice, and it fits the scenery here very well."
The two of them stopped no longer and walked slowly towards the east side of the Misty Rain Forest. The skylight slowly fades in the forest, warm light and shadow slowly soften among the branches and leaves, and twilight quietly permeates the entire forest. While walking, a clear and melodious sound of running water penetrated the mist and lingered faintly in my ears. The two of them followed the sound of gurgling water and slowly went deeper into the hinterland. Finally, Luo Zhizheng and Li Ziyun arrived at the front section of Ximing Valley.
Here is the Ximing Valley Stream to the east of the Misty Rain Forest.
This place is located on the south side of the dense forest along the coast of the Endless East China Sea, about thirty kilometers away from the shoals along the coast of the Endless East China Sea.
The entire valley is long and narrow, scattered along the terrain, winding and twisting all the way, slowly extending towards the deepest part of the dense forest. A clear mountain stream runs through the valley. The stream flows slowly along the uneven rocky shore. The water hits the gravel and gurgls endlessly. The sound of clear water is continuous and echoes leisurely in the quiet forest valley. On both sides of the stream bank, slender and strong green bamboos grow in clusters, tall and straight, with whirling green leaves, and are intertwined with tall broad-leafed old trees with vigorous branches. Dense branches are intertwined vertically and horizontally, broad leaves are covered with dense shade, bamboo shadows are scattered at random, and layers of branches and leaves are densely covered on the valley.
The soft and slow sunset shadows fall slantly through the gaps between the overlapping branches and leaves, spreading lightly on the wet mud floor and bluestone slabs, and then sprinkle on the surface of the flowing stream, reflecting pieces of swaying and sparkling light spots. The valley is cool and humid, with abundant water vapor. A light mist floats lightly between the stream and the bamboo forest, making the entire valley even more hazy and deep. This place is hidden deep in the hinterland of the misty rainforest, surrounded by trees on all sides. The valley mouth is hidden and narrow, and the valley road is winding and clumsy. It is naturally isolated from outside sounds and sight, making it highly concealed.
Luo Zhi was standing at the mouth of the valley, his eyes slowly sweeping across the long and narrow valley and the clear and shallow stream running through it, taking in all the surrounding terrain and scenery. He pondered for a moment, and then slowly said: "The valley here is deep, the forest is quiet, and the stream is ringing. Let's call it the Ming Valley."
Li Ziyun walked aside slowly, raised his eyes to look at the continuous bamboo trees and the gurgling water, his eyebrows were soft, he nodded gently, and responded softly: "The stream Minggujian, the name is elegant and appropriate, and it is perfectly suitable for the temperament of this valley."
The two of them quietly looked around their surroundings. The internal injuries caused by the pressure of the blue dragon had not yet healed. The day's running and fighting had already taken a huge amount of wear and tear. The stagnant internal injuries in their bodies ached faintly. In addition, the light and shadow in the forest became increasingly dim, and twilight completely enveloped the valley. It was no longer inconvenient to continue on their way.
The two of them had the same mind and decided to find a safe place to stay and rest temporarily in the front section of Ximing Valley.
They avoided the wet and cold stream banks and found a flat, dry and wind-proof area with bamboo behind them. This place was hidden, safe and far away from the moisture of the stream, making it perfect for resting for the night.
Then the two of them split up and walked slowly in the surrounding forest. Together they picked up scattered dry branches, dead bamboos, and broken dead wood. They gathered and stacked them together to create a small pile of dry firewood.
Luo Zhizheng knelt down and reached into his trouser pocket to take out a waterproof lighter. He lowered his eyes in front of the firewood pile, flicked the switch with his fingertips, and a warm and bright flame suddenly ignited. He leaned over slightly and carefully ignited the twigs at the bottom. He slowly started the fire with the evening breeze and steadily ignited the whole pile of dead branches little by little.
The warm yellow bonfire danced slowly, dispersing the coolness and dampness of the valley. The flickering light of the fire illuminated the slightly tired brows of the two people, and also added a sense of stable warmth to this deep and hazy valley.
The twilight is getting thicker, the chill is gradually rising in the depths of the valley, and there are waves of hunger in the belly. Li Ziyun raised his hand slightly, flicked his fingertips to the storage bag hanging at his waist, and took out two firm pieces of spirit badger meat.
Seeing this, Luo Zhizheng silently picked up two dry branches of moderate thickness from the campfire, raised his hand and took off the bone knife from his waist. The blade was cold white and sharp. He crouched beside him, holding the handle of the knife firmly with his fingertips, and slowly and slowly sharpened one end of the branch, with neat and steady movements.
After handling it properly, he reached out and took two pieces of spirit badger meat from Li Ziyun's hand. He skewered the meat pieces firmly on the shaved wooden branches, raised his hands and placed them on the edge of the bonfire, and slowly roasted them with the warm fire.
The flames roared quietly, and under the slow fire, the badger meat placed beside the campfire gradually lost its raw smell, and the surface was grilled until it was shiny and translucent, and the whole body glowed with a warm, burnt golden color. The fine oil drips slowly along the meat lines, making a soft crackling sound when it falls on the firewood. The mellow meat aroma is mixed with the clear water vapor in the valley, slowly permeating the surroundings.
After a while, the two pieces of badger meat were already cooked, with slightly charred skin and firm and fragrant meat.
Luo Zhi was raising his hand to take down a bunch of the most golden and shiny barbecue. He held the wooden branch firmly with his fingertips and handed it to Li Ziyun sideways. He looked gentle and said in a calm tone: "Come on, you must be hungry after a day of running around. Eat something first and build up your strength before you can stabilize your internal injuries."
Li Ziyun took the barbecue and gently held the wooden pole with his fingertips. Due to the unrecovered internal injuries, his movements were gentle and slow. She lowered her eyebrows and chewed carefully. The warm meat entered her stomach, slowly soothing her hunger and physical weakness after a day of running around. She raised her eyes to look at Luo Zhizheng and said softly: "You should eat quickly, you must be hungry too."
Luo Zhizheng nodded slightly, reached out and picked up another skewer of barbecue, and started eating it in big gulps. The warm spirit and flesh slowly entered the abdomen, and a gentle energy slowly melted away, slightly relieving the stagnant internal injuries in the body and the fatigue from working all day long.
After the two of them finished eating the barbecue, all the hunger in their stomachs was gone, and their throats were slightly dry.
Luo Zhizheng reached out and took off the silver moon water bag from his waist, pulled out the cork, handed it to Li Ziyun, and said softly: "I just finished eating barbecue, drink some water to moisten your throat."
Li Ziyun took the water bag and slowly drank a few sips. The clear stream water moistened his throat and soothed the dryness in his throat. She raised her hand and gently wiped the corners of her lips, then steadily handed the water bag back to Luo Zhizheng.
Luo Zhizheng reached out to take it, raised his head and drank a few sips, then carefully stuffed the cork, tied the silver moon water bag back to his waist and stored it properly.
After eating and drinking enough, warmth spreads all over the body, and the fatigue of traveling for days has faded slightly.
The night is getting darker, the evening breeze is blowing gently in the forest, mixed with the gentle sound of the gurgling stream, and the surroundings are especially quiet.
Luo Zhi was sitting down slowly with his back against the bamboo bushes. He looked at Li Ziyun beside him and saw that her face was still a little weak. He said softly: "You have been running through a thrilling journey today and you have suffered a lot. It is safe here tonight. You can calm down and adjust your breathing to stabilize your internal injuries."
Li Ziyun nodded slightly, adjusted his sitting posture, slowly closed his eyes, calmed down, and began to circulate his breath to nurse the injury.
Luo Zhizheng stayed by the bonfire, adding dead branches from time to time to keep the fire burning steadily. While vigilantly paying attention to the movements around the valley and guarding against nocturnal monsters, he closed his eyes and calmed his mind, and adjusted his breathing simultaneously to slowly calm down the surging energy and blood in his body and repair the damage left by the day's fighting and running.
title_en: Chapter 23: The misty rain forest hides the tranquility, and the stream is peaceful at night. Chapter 24: Morning stream with shadows, encountering spiritual flowers in the valley
